diagnosis.root_cause: Full-client 21:9 sourceAspect was universally used for both title/menu and Ferrari/car-select though native game publishes distinct GameState and Quest3 showed title stretched but source crop cuts selector images. Existing imageMatteVerified is permanently false, so prior safe conservative path could never correct known stretched title separately from selector.
diagnosis.original_evidence: Issue #119 user A/B tested Quest3: crop OFF title looks horizontally stretched, crop ON cuts yellow Ferrari/right vehicle list. Original host R23 used same sampled aspect regardless ClientGameStateIndex; new branch reads actual 0x04/0x09 versus 0x0A..0x0C.
source_trace: Native OutRun GameState is published in V2 IPC reserved word 5 with presentation source metadata.

Host SharedWriter::GameState accesses original state with HeaderValid guard; R23 uses exact state to select source-authorized optical aspect only for title/main menu when full client is captured and letterboxing confirmed.
Menu cache invalidates on state change; source UV and stereo common intersected FOV/anchor remain untouched.
diagnosis.limitations: Preservation of all source pixels with title optical 4:3 can alter full-width custom title art. Explicit OUTRUN_VR_MENU_NATIVE_ASPECT=1 restores full client proportions; Quest3 HMD acceptance is required.
